text:
maria_sanchez: Heads-up — KestrelAI dropped to ~8% of their normal API tokens this week after the live demo on Mon. Link to internal usage chart: https://redwood.internal/usage/kestrelai (private). Can we triage? Renewal in ~6 weeks. Not sure if this is procurement freeze or a technical blocker. @aj_patel any notes from sales? :eyes:

aj_patel: We had a call Wed — they mentioned price sensitivity and a parallel POC with EmberML. Procurement asked for SSO and an on-prem pricing option. I flagged this to them but haven't given a formal quote. I'll ping their procurement now and loop in the new ML lead. cc @sophia_ng

ben_kwon: Quick technical ask — can someone paste the last 7d tokens by route? I want to check if they're hitting model fallbacks or if latency/cost caused them to throttle. If KV cache got warmed down that could explain a cost spike.

sophia_ng: Trying to schedule enablement but contacts changed mid-week — new ML lead listed as R. Liu, I haven't gotten a response. I sent the onboarding guide last Thurs. Also customer reported a few hallucination examples in summarization that worried the product team.

maria_sanchez: I ran a quick query: `SELECT route, SUM(tokens) FROM api_requests WHERE org='kestrelai' AND ts >= now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY route;` Results: /chat ~1.2k tokens (baseline ~15k), /embed ~200 (baseline ~1.5k). No sustained latency spikes in APM, errors ~0.3% (was 0.1%). Looks more like a seat freeze vs infra issue.

ben_kwon: Thanks — that aligns with a usage freeze. I'll check logs for API key rotations and any model-fallback traces. If they're evaluating EmberML we should check model & quantization deltas.

deploy-bot: Incident alert — cluster 'dedicated-kestrel' scaled down worker pool in us-west-2 at 2028-03-04T03:12Z due to autoscaler policy. Notifying eng-infra.

aj_patel: Quick update from procurement: they want a consolidated quote including on-prem/private pricing and specifics about SLAs for the dedicated option. They've scheduled a tech bakeoff with EmberML next Tue. Marking renewal as at-risk.

sophia_ng: Proposed immediate plan: 1) outreach to the new ML lead to re-establish trust 2) assemble a short competitive comparison focused on latency/cost/QA 3) offer a 1-week free dedicated pilot for their top routes so they can validate performance without committing. Thoughts?

ben_kwon: I can draft the perf & cost comparison (include 95p latency, CPU/GPU targets, cost per 1M tokens) and run a quick benchmark on our infra to validate numbers. I'll need product to confirm quantization options and recommended models for the POC.

maria_sanchez: Assigning owners: @aj_patel — lead customer communications & commercial quote; @sophia_ng — enablement & pilot runbook; @ben_kwon — technical compare + logs. I'll prepare an account health note for CRO. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

aj_patel: Ping — KestrelAI replied: they want the consolidated quote by Fri EOD and a sync Fri 9am PT. Sophia, can you have the pilot runbook ready by Thu? Ben, can you share perf deltas by Wed? Thanks team.
